purchase_create_failed: Failed to create the purchase order
purchase_update_failed: Failed to update the purchase order
purchase_receive_successfully: Goods received and added to stock
transfer_create_failed: Failed to send the stock transfer
transfer_receive_failed: Failed to receive the stock transfer
transfer_cancel_successfully: Stock transfer cancelled and stock returned to the sender
transfer_cancel_failed: Failed to cancel the stock transfer
supplier_duplicate: A supplier with this name already exists
supplier_in_use: The supplier has open purchase orders or unpaid bills; mark it inactive instead
supplier_invalid: The supplier does not exist or is inactive
order_invalid_status: The order's status does not allow this action
order_invalid_lines: Choose at least one line of the order with a received quantity above 0
order_has_receipts: Goods have already been received for this order, so it cannot be cancelled; close it instead
transfer_invalid_destination: Invalid receiving branch (it does not exist or is the sending branch)
transfer_invalid_status: The stock transfer has already been received or cancelled
transfer_wrong_branch: Only the receiving branch can receive; only the sending branch can cancel
transfer_invalid_lines: The received quantity cannot exceed the quantity sent
bill_already_paid: This bill is already fully paid
bill_amount_exceeds: The payment exceeds the amount still owed
